title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Gaylord Entertainment Center, Nashville | 2000
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Gaylord Entertainment Center, Nashville, Tennessee, USA, on 31 May 2000.

It was the 15th show by the sixth All-Starr Band. Their North American tour lasted for 32 dates between May and July 2000.

The sixth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Dave Edmunds: vocals, guitar
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Eric Carmen: vocals, keyboards, guitar, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, guitar, organ, keyboards, percussion, harmonica
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums

They were joined for this show by The Police’s Andy Summers on guitar during ‘Theme For An Imaginary Western’, and Pam Tillis, Kim Carnes, Tom Hambridge, and Sam Bush during ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’.
